task_name: Large-Scale Qubit Interning & Bounded L1/L2 Grid Scaling (LineQubit N=2048, GridQubit 64x64)

optimizations: Expanded _FAST_LINE_QUBIT_CACHE from 512 to 2048 entries (16.4 KB, 100% L1 cache fit)
Expanded _FAST_GRID_QUBIT_CACHE from 32x32 to 64x64 entries (36 KB, 4096 qubits, covering up to d=31 Surface Code patches)
Implemented strict subclass isolation in LineQubit.__new__, LineQid.__new__, GridQubit.__new__, and GridQid.__new__ to eliminate subclass cache pollution
Inlined boundary guards 0 <= x < 2048 and 0 <= row < 64 and 0 <= col < 64 to prevent negative index wrapping in Python list subscription
Added comprehensive unit test suites in line_qubit_test.py and grid_qubit_test.py for 2048/64x64 cache hits, negative/out-of-bound fallbacks, and subclass polymorphism
